fusions.name: Thundering Tilt
fusions.desc: You charge up to 8 tiles at an enemy behind a lance of arcana, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Phantom Herd
fusions.desc: Calls a phantom stampede through every enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Conjured Steed
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Gathering Gallop
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
